        /**\n
         * Get theme from localStorage (simple string format)\n
         * @returns {string|null} Theme value or null\n
         */\n
        function getStoredTheme() {\n
            try {\n
                const value = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);\n
                return value === 'dark' ? 'dark' : (value === 'light' ? 'light' : null);\n
            } catch (e) {\n
                return null;\n
            }\n
        }\n

        /**\n
         * Store theme in localStorage (simple string format)\n
         * @param {string} theme - Theme value ('light' or 'dark')\n
         */\n
        function setStoredTheme(theme) {\n
            const normalized = theme === 'dark' ? 'dark' : 'light';\n
            try {\n
                localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, normalized);\n
            } catch (e) {\n
                // Ignore storage errors (private browsing, quota exceeded)\n

        /**\n
         * Apply theme to document root\n
         * @param {string} theme - Theme value ('light' or 'dark')\n

        function applyTheme(theme) {\n
            const normalized = theme === 'dark' ? 'dark' : 'light';\n
            const root = document.documentElement;\n
\n
            if (normalized === 'dark') {\n
                root.classList.add('dark');\n
                root.setAttribute('data-theme', 'dark');\n
            } else {\n

                root.setAttribute('data-theme', 'light');\n
            }\n

            this.theme = localStorage.getItem('theme') || 'light';\n
        } catch (error) {\n
            this.theme = 'light';\n
        }\n
\n
        // Listen for theme changes from other components\n
        window.addEventListener('theme-changed', (e) => {\n
            this.theme = e.detail?.theme || 'light';\n
        });\n
    }\n

        /**\n
         * Get theme from localStorage (simple string format)\n
         * @returns {string|null} Theme value or null\n
         */\n
        function getStoredTheme() {\n
            try {\n
                const value = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);\n
                return value === 'dark' ? 'dark' : (value === 'light' ? 'light' : null);\n
            } catch (e) {\n
                return null;\n
            }\n
        }\n

        /**\n
         * Store theme in localStorage (simple string format)\n
         * @param {string} theme - Theme value ('light' or 'dark')\n
         */\n
        function setStoredTheme(theme) {\n
            const normalized = theme === 'dark' ? 'dark' : 'light';\n
            try {\n
                localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, normalized);\n
            } catch (e) {\n
                // Ignore storage errors (private browsing, quota exceeded)\n
            }\n
        }\n

        /**\n
         * Apply theme to document root\n
         * @param {string} theme - Theme value ('light' or 'dark')\n
         */\n
        function applyTheme(theme) {\n
            const normalized = theme === 'dark' ? 'dark' : 'light';\n
            const root = document.documentElement;\n
\n
            if (normalized === 'dark') {\n
                root.classList.add('dark');\n
                root.setAttribute('data-theme', 'dark');\n
            } else {\n
                root.classList.remove('dark');\n
                root.setAttribute('data-theme', 'light');\n
            }\n
\n
            setStoredTheme(normalized);\n
        }\n

        function getStoredTheme() {\n

        /**\n

        function setStoredTheme(theme) {\n
            const normalized = theme === 'dark' ? 'dark' : 'light';\n
            try {\n

            const root = document.documentElement;\n

            }\n

         * @returns {string|null} Theme value or null\n
         */\n
        function getStoredTheme() {\n
            try {\n
                const value = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);\n
                return value === 'dark' ? 'dark' : (value === 'light' ? 'light' : null);\n

                return null;\n

        /**\n

        function setStoredTheme(theme) {\n
            const normalized = theme === 'dark' ? 'dark' : 'light';\n

        function getStoredTheme() {\n

                return value === 'dark' ? 'dark' : (value === 'light' ? 'light' : null);\n

         */\n
        function setStoredTheme(theme) {\n
            const normalized = theme === 'dark' ? 'dark' : 'light';\n
            try {\n

            } catch (e) {\n

        function applyTheme(theme) {\n
            const normalized = theme === 'dark' ? 'dark' : 'light';\n
            const root = document.documentElement;\n

            }\n

        const DEFAULT_THEME = 'light'; // Immutable default per v3.6.0\n
\n
        /**\n
         * Get theme from localStorage (simple string format)\n
         * @returns {string|null} Theme value or null\n
         */\n
        function getStoredTheme() {\n
            try {\n
                const value = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);\n
                return value === 'dark' ? 'dark' : (value === 'light' ? 'light' : null);\n
            } catch (e) {\n
                return null;\n
            }\n
        }\n
\n
        /**\n
         * Store theme in localStorage (simple string format)\n
         * @param {string} theme - Theme value ('light' or 'dark')\n
         */\n
        function setStoredTheme(theme) {\n
            const normalized = theme === 'dark' ? 'dark' : 'light';\n
            try {\n
                localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, normalized);\n
            } catch (e) {\n
                // Ignore storage errors (private browsing, quota exceeded)\n
            }\n
        }\n
\n
        /**\n
         * Apply theme to document root\n
         * @param {string} theme - Theme value ('light' or 'dark')\n
         */\n
        function applyTheme(theme) {\n
            const normalized = theme === 'dark' ? 'dark' : 'light';\n
            const root = document.documentElement;\n
\n
            if (normalized === 'dark') {\n
                root.classList.add('dark');\n
                root.setAttribute('data-theme', 'dark');\n
            } else {\n
                root.classList.remove('dark');\n
                root.setAttribute('data-theme', 'light');\n
            }\n
\n
            setStoredTheme(normalized);\n
        }\n
\n
        // Initialize theme: stored > default (light)\n
        // v3.6.0: No system preference detection\n
        const initialTheme = getStoredTheme() || DEFAULT_THEME;\n
        applyTheme(initialTheme);\n
\n
        // Expose global theme API for components\n
        window.ICTServeTheme = {\n
            get: function() {\n
                return getStoredTheme() || DEFAULT_THEME;\n
            },\n
            set: function(theme) {\n
                applyTheme(theme);\n
                // Dispatch event for reactive components\n
                window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('theme-changed', {\n
                    detail: {\n
                        theme: theme === 'dark' ? 'dark' : 'light'\n
                    }\n
                }));\n
            },\n
            toggle: function() {\n
                const current = this.get();\n
                const next = current === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark';\n
                this.set(next);\n
                return next;\n
            }\n
        };\n
    })();\n
</script>\n

            this.theme = localStorage.getItem('theme') || 'light';\n
        } catch (error) {\n
            this.theme = 'light';\n
        }\n
\n
        // Listen for theme changes from other components\n
        window.addEventListener('theme-changed', (e) => {\n
            this.theme = e.detail?.theme || 'light';\n
        });\n
    }\n

        function getStoredTheme() {\n

        /**\n
         * Get theme from localStorage (simple string format)\n
         * @returns {string|null} Theme value or null\n
         */\n
        function getStoredTheme() {\n
            try {\n
                const value = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);\n
                return value === 'dark' ? 'dark' : (value === 'light' ? 'light' : null);\n
            } catch (e) {\n
                return null;\n
            }\n
        }\n
\n
        /**\n
         * Store theme in localStorage (simple string format)\n
         * @param {string} theme - Theme value ('light' or 'dark')\n
         */\n
        function setStoredTheme(theme) {\n
            const normalized = theme === 'dark' ? 'dark' : 'light';\n
            try {\n
                localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, normalized);\n
            } catch (e) {\n
                // Ignore storage errors (private browsing, quota exceeded)\n
            }\n
        }\n

        /**\n
         * Apply theme to document root\n
         * @param {string} theme - Theme value ('light' or 'dark')\n
         */\n
        function applyTheme(theme) {\n
            const normalized = theme === 'dark' ? 'dark' : 'light';\n
            const root = document.documentElement;\n
\n
            if (normalized === 'dark') {\n
                root.classList.add('dark');\n
                root.setAttribute('data-theme', 'dark');\n
            } else {\n
                root.classList.remove('dark');\n
                root.setAttribute('data-theme', 'light');\n
            }\n
\n
            setStoredTheme(normalized);\n
        }\n
\n
        // Initialize theme: stored > default (light)\n
        // v3.6.0: No system preference detection\n
        const initialTheme = getStoredTheme() || DEFAULT_THEME;\n
        applyTheme(initialTheme);\n
\n
        // Expose global theme API for components\n
        window.ICTServeTheme = {\n
            get: function() {\n
                return getStoredTheme() || DEFAULT_THEME;\n

                applyTheme(theme);\n
                // Dispatch event for reactive components\n

                    detail: {\n

                    }\n

         * @returns {string|null} Theme value or null\n
         */\n
        function getStoredTheme() {\n
            try {\n
                const value = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);\n
                return value === 'dark' ? 'dark' : (value === 'light' ? 'light' : null);\n
            } catch (e) {\n
                return null;\n
            }\n
        }\n
\n
        /**\n
         * Store theme in localStorage (simple string format)\n
         * @param {string} theme - Theme value ('light' or 'dark')\n
         */\n
        function setStoredTheme(theme) {\n
            const normalized = theme === 'dark' ? 'dark' : 'light';\n
            try {\n
                localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, normalized);\n
            } catch (e) {\n
                // Ignore storage errors (private browsing, quota exceeded)\n
            }\n
        }\n
\n
        /**\n
         * Apply theme to document root\n
         * @param {string} theme - Theme value ('light' or 'dark')\n
         */\n
        function applyTheme(theme) {\n
            const normalized = theme === 'dark' ? 'dark' : 'light';\n
            const root = document.documentElement;\n
\n
            if (normalized === 'dark') {\n
                root.classList.add('dark');\n
                root.setAttribute('data-theme', 'dark');\n
            } else {\n
                root.classList.remove('dark');\n
                root.setAttribute('data-theme', 'light');\n
            }\n
\n
            setStoredTheme(normalized);\n
        }\n
\n
        // Initialize theme: stored > default (light)\n
        // v3.6.0: No system preference detection\n
        const initialTheme = getStoredTheme() || DEFAULT_THEME;\n
        applyTheme(initialTheme);\n
\n
        // Expose global theme API for components\n
        window.ICTServeTheme = {\n
            get: function() {\n
                return getStoredTheme() || DEFAULT_THEME;\n
            },\n
            set: function(theme) {\n
                applyTheme(theme);\n
                // Dispatch event for reactive components\n
                window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('theme-changed', {\n
                    detail: {\n
                        theme: theme === 'dark' ? 'dark' : 'light'\n
                    }\n
                }));\n
            },\n
            toggle: function() {\n
                const current = this.get();\n
                const next = current === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark';\n
                this.set(next);\n
                return next;\n
            }\n
        };\n
    })();\n
</script>\n

        try {\n
            this.theme = localStorage.getItem('theme') || 'light';\n
        } catch (error) {\n
            this.theme = 'light';\n
        }\n
\n
        // Listen for theme changes from other components\n
        window.addEventListener('theme-changed', (e) => {\n
            this.theme = e.detail?.theme || 'light';\n
        });\n
    }\n
}" class="inline-flex">\n

        /**\n

         * @returns {string|null} Theme value or null\n
         */\n
        function getStoredTheme() {\n
            try {\n
                const value = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);\n
                return value === 'dark' ? 'dark' : (value === 'light' ? 'light' : null);\n
            } catch (e) {\n
                return null;\n

        /**\n
         * Store theme in localStorage (simple string format)\n

         */\n
        function setStoredTheme(theme) {\n
            const normalized = theme === 'dark' ? 'dark' : 'light';\n
            try {\n
                localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, normalized);\n
            } catch (e) {\n
                // Ignore storage errors (private browsing, quota exceeded)\n

        /**\n

        function applyTheme(theme) {\n
            const normalized = theme === 'dark' ? 'dark' : 'light';\n
            const root = document.documentElement;\n

            if (normalized === 'dark') {\n

    <script>\n
    (function() {\n
        'use strict';\n
\n
        // Prevent multiple initializations\n
        if (window.__ictserveThemeInit) return;\n
        window.__ictserveThemeInit = true;\n
\n
        const STORAGE_KEY = 'theme';\n
        const DEFAULT_THEME = 'light'; // Immutable default per v3.6.0\n
\n
        /**\n
         * Get theme from localStorage (simple string format)\n
         * @returns {string|null} Theme value or null\n
         */\n
        function getStoredTheme() {\n
            try {\n
                const value = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);\n
                return value === 'dark' ? 'dark' : (value === 'light' ? 'light' : null);\n
            } catch (e) {\n
                return null;\n
            }\n
        }\n
\n
        /**\n
         * Store theme in localStorage (simple string format)\n
         * @param {string} theme - Theme value ('light' or 'dark')\n
         */\n
        function setStoredTheme(theme) {\n
            const normalized = theme === 'dark' ? 'dark' : 'light';\n
            try {\n
                localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, normalized);\n
            } catch (e) {\n
                // Ignore storage errors (private browsing, quota exceeded)\n
            }\n
        }\n
\n
        /**\n
         * Apply theme to document root\n
         * @param {string} theme - Theme value ('light' or 'dark')\n
         */\n
        function applyTheme(theme) {\n
            const normalized = theme === 'dark' ? 'dark' : 'light';\n
            const root = document.documentElement;\n
\n
            if (normalized === 'dark') {\n
                root.classList.add('dark');\n
                root.setAttribute('data-theme', 'dark');\n
            } else {\n
                root.classList.remove('dark');\n
                root.setAttribute('data-theme', 'light');\n
            }\n
\n
            setStoredTheme(normalized);\n
        }\n
\n
        // Initialize theme: stored > default (light)\n
        // v3.6.0: No system preference detection\n
        const initialTheme = getStoredTheme() || DEFAULT_THEME;\n
        applyTheme(initialTheme);\n
\n
        // Expose global theme API for components\n
        window.ICTServeTheme = {\n
            get: function() {\n
                return getStoredTheme() || DEFAULT_THEME;\n
            },\n
            set: function(theme) {\n
                applyTheme(theme);\n
                // Dispatch event for reactive components\n
                window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('theme-changed', {\n
                    detail: {\n
                        theme: theme === 'dark' ? 'dark' : 'light'\n
                    }\n
                }));\n
            },\n
            toggle: function() {\n
                const current = this.get();\n
                const next = current === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark';\n
                this.set(next);\n
                return next;\n
            }\n
        };\n
    })();\n
</script>\n

<script>\n
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {\n
        const skipNav = document.querySelector('[data-skip-links]');\n
\n
        if (!skipNav) {\n
            return;\n
        }\n
\n
        const skipLinks = skipNav.querySelectorAll('[data-skip-link]');\n
        const hiddenTop = '-1000px';\n
\n
        const hideSkipLinks = () => {\n
            skipNav.style.top = hiddenTop;\n
            skipNav.style.opacity = '0';\n
            skipNav.style.pointerEvents = 'none';\n
            skipNav.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');\n
            skipLinks.forEach((link) => link.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1'));\n
        };\n
\n
        const showSkipLinks = () => {\n
            skipNav.style.top = '1rem';\n
            skipNav.style.opacity = '1';\n
            skipNav.style.pointerEvents = 'auto';\n
            skipNav.removeAttribute('aria-hidden');\n
            skipLinks.forEach((link) => link.setAttribute('tabindex', '0'));\n
        };\n
\n
        hideSkipLinks();\n
\n
        skipNav.addEventListener('focusin', showSkipLinks);\n
        skipNav.addEventListener('focusout', (event) => {\n
            if (!skipNav.contains(event.relatedTarget)) {\n
                hideSkipLinks();\n
            }\n
        });\n
\n
    });\n
</script>\n

            const attachHandlers = () => {\n
                const refreshTarget = document.querySelector('[data-dashboard-refresh]');\n
\n
                if (!refreshTarget) {\n
                    return;\n
                }\n
\n
                const applyFocusStyles = () => {\n
                    refreshTarget.style.boxShadow =\n
                        '0 0 0 3px rgba(0, 86, 179, 0.5), 0 0 0 5px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.95)';\n
                    refreshTarget.style.outline = 'none';\n
                    refreshTarget.classList.add('dashboard-refresh-focused');\n
                };\n
\n
                const focusRefresh = () => {\n
                    if (document.hasFocus()) {\n
                        if (document.activeElement !== refreshTarget) {\n
                            refreshTarget.focus();\n
                        }\n
                        applyFocusStyles();\n
                    }\n
                };\n
\n
                refreshTarget.addEventListener('blur', () => {\n
                    refreshTarget.classList.remove('dashboard-refresh-focused');\n
                    refreshTarget.style.boxShadow = '';\n
                    refreshTarget.style.outline = '';\n
                });\n
\n
                window.requestAnimationFrame(() => {\n
                    setTimeout(focusRefresh, 150);\n
                });\n
\n
                const handleFirstTab = (event) => {\n
                    if (event.key !== 'Tab' || event.shiftKey) {\n
                        return;\n
                    }\n
\n
                    event.preventDefault();\n
                    focusRefresh();\n
                    document.removeEventListener('keydown', handleFirstTab, true);\n
                };\n
\n
                document.addEventListener('keydown', handleFirstTab, true);\n
            };\n
\n
            if (document.readyState === 'complete' || document.readyState === 'interactive') {\n
                attachHandlers();\n
            } else {\n
                document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', attachHandlers, {\n
                    once: true\n
                });\n
            }\n
        })();\n

    <script>\n
    (function() {\n
        'use strict';\n
\n
        // Prevent multiple initializations\n
        if (window.__ictserveThemeInit) return;\n
        window.__ictserveThemeInit = true;\n
\n
        const STORAGE_KEY = 'theme';\n
        const DEFAULT_THEME = 'light'; // Immutable default per v3.6.0\n
\n
        /**\n
         * Get theme from localStorage (simple string format)\n
         * @returns {string|null} Theme value or null\n
         */\n
        function getStoredTheme() {\n
            try {\n
                const value = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);\n
                return value === 'dark' ? 'dark' : (value === 'light' ? 'light' : null);\n
            } catch (e) {\n
                return null;\n
            }\n
        }\n
\n
        /**\n
         * Store theme in localStorage (simple string format)\n
         * @param {string} theme - Theme value ('light' or 'dark')\n
         */\n
        function setStoredTheme(theme) {\n
            const normalized = theme === 'dark' ? 'dark' : 'light';\n
            try {\n
                localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, normalized);\n
            } catch (e) {\n
                // Ignore storage errors (private browsing, quota exceeded)\n
            }\n
        }\n
\n
        /**\n
         * Apply theme to document root\n
         * @param {string} theme - Theme value ('light' or 'dark')\n
         */\n
        function applyTheme(theme) {\n
            const normalized = theme === 'dark' ? 'dark' : 'light';\n
            const root = document.documentElement;\n
\n
            if (normalized === 'dark') {\n
                root.classList.add('dark');\n
                root.setAttribute('data-theme', 'dark');\n
            } else {\n
                root.classList.remove('dark');\n
                root.setAttribute('data-theme', 'light');\n
            }\n
\n
            setStoredTheme(normalized);\n
        }\n
\n
        // Initialize theme: stored > default (light)\n
        // v3.6.0: No system preference detection\n
        const initialTheme = getStoredTheme() || DEFAULT_THEME;\n
        applyTheme(initialTheme);\n
\n
        // Expose global theme API for components\n
        window.ICTServeTheme = {\n
            get: function() {\n
                return getStoredTheme() || DEFAULT_THEME;\n
            },\n
            set: function(theme) {\n
                applyTheme(theme);\n
                // Dispatch event for reactive components\n
                window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('theme-changed', {\n
                    detail: {\n
                        theme: theme === 'dark' ? 'dark' : 'light'\n
                    }\n
                }));\n
            },\n
            toggle: function() {\n
                const current = this.get();\n
                const next = current === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark';\n
                this.set(next);\n
                return next;\n
            }\n
        };\n
    })();\n

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {\n

        if (!skipNav) {\n
            return;\n
        }\n
\n
        const skipLinks = skipNav.querySelectorAll('[data-skip-link]');\n
        const hiddenTop = '-1000px';\n
\n
        const hideSkipLinks = () => {\n
            skipNav.style.top = hiddenTop;\n
            skipNav.style.opacity = '0';\n
            skipNav.style.pointerEvents = 'none';\n
            skipNav.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');\n
            skipLinks.forEach((link) => link.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1'));\n
        };\n
\n
        const showSkipLinks = () => {\n
            skipNav.style.top = '1rem';\n
            skipNav.style.opacity = '1';\n

            skipNav.removeAttribute('aria-hidden');\n
            skipLinks.forEach((link) => link.setAttribute('tabindex', '0'));\n

        hideSkipLinks();\n

        skipNav.addEventListener('focusin', showSkipLinks);\n

        });\n

            <script wire:snapshot="{&quot;data&quot;:{&quot;showWarning&quot;:false,&quot;remainingSeconds&quot;:120},&quot;memo&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;AkbNa4vL8RCpUJSVjInC&quot;,&quot;name&quot;:&quot;session-timeout-warning&quot;,&quot;path&quot;:&quot;staff\/profile&quot;,&quot;method&quot;:&quot;GET&quot;,&quot;release&quot;:&quot;a-a-a&quot;,&quot;children&quot;:[],&quot;scripts&quot;:[],&quot;assets&quot;:[],&quot;errors&quot;:[],&quot;locale&quot;:&quot;ms&quot;},&quot;checksum&quot;:&quot;61d1834557522f14060c0717b4f4594960b41e6961f5a8140015824545d1c2e7&quot;}" wire:effects="{&quot;partials&quot;:[],&quot;listeners&quot;:[&quot;show-timeout-warning&quot;]}" wire:id="AkbNa4vL8RCpUJSVjInC">\n
// Define Alpine data IMMEDIATELY before it's used by the component\n
document.addEventListener('alpine:init', () => {\n
    Alpine.data('sessionTimeout', () => ({\n
        // Session timeout: 30 minutes (1800 seconds)\n
        sessionTimeout: 1800,\n
        // Warning at 28 minutes (1680 seconds)\n
        warningThreshold: 1680,\n
        // Countdown interval\n
        countdownInterval: null,\n
        // Time elapsed since last activity\n
        elapsedSeconds: 0,\n
        // Remaining seconds before logout\n
        remainingSeconds: 120,\n
\n
        init() {\n
            // Start monitoring session activity\n
            this.startMonitoring();\n
\n
            // Listen for session extension event\n
            Livewire.on('session-extended', () => {\n
                this.resetTimer();\n
            });\n
\n
            // Reset timer on user activity\n
            ['mousedown', 'keydown', 'scroll', 'touchstart'].forEach(event => {\n
                document.addEventListener(event, () => this.resetTimer(), { passive: true });\n
            });\n
        },\n
\n
        startMonitoring() {\n
            // Check session status every second\n
            setInterval(() => {\n
                this.elapsedSeconds++;\n
\n
                // Show warning at 28 minutes\n
                if (this.elapsedSeconds === this.warningThreshold) {\n
                    window.Livewire.find('AkbNa4vL8RCpUJSVjInC').call('showWarning');\n
                    this.startCountdown();\n
                }\n
\n
                // Force logout at 30 minutes\n
                if (this.elapsedSeconds >= this.sessionTimeout) {\n
                    window.Livewire.find('AkbNa4vL8RCpUJSVjInC').call('logout');\n
                }\n
            }, 1000);\n
        },\n
\n
        startCountdown() {\n
            // Update remaining time every second\n
            this.countdownInterval = setInterval(() => {\n
                this.remainingSeconds--;\n
\n
                if (this.remainingSeconds <= 0) {\n
                    clearInterval(this.countdownInterval);\n
                    window.Livewire.find('AkbNa4vL8RCpUJSVjInC').call('logout');\n
                }\n
            }, 1000);\n
        },\n
\n
        resetTimer() {\n
            this.elapsedSeconds = 0;\n
            this.remainingSeconds = 120;\n
\n
            if (this.countdownInterval) {\n
                clearInterval(this.countdownInterval);\n
                this.countdownInterval = null;\n
            }\n
        },\n
\n
        formatTime(seconds) {\n
            const minutes = Math.floor(seconds / 60);\n
            const secs = seconds % 60;\n
            return `${minutes}:${secs.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;\n
        }\n
    }));\n
});\n
</script>\n

        /**\n

         * @returns {string|null} Theme value or null\n
         */\n
        function getStoredTheme() {\n
            try {\n
                const value = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);\n
                return value === 'dark' ? 'dark' : (value === 'light' ? 'light' : null);\n
            } catch (e) {\n
                return null;\n
            }\n

        /**\n
         * Store theme in localStorage (simple string format)\n
         * @param {string} theme - Theme value ('light' or 'dark')\n
         */\n
        function setStoredTheme(theme) {\n
            const normalized = theme === 'dark' ? 'dark' : 'light';\n
            try {\n
                localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, normalized);\n
            } catch (e) {\n
                // Ignore storage errors (private browsing, quota exceeded)\n

        /**\n
         * Apply theme to document root\n

            const normalized = theme === 'dark' ? 'dark' : 'light';\n
            const root = document.documentElement;\n

            if (normalized === 'dark') {\n

                root.setAttribute('data-theme', 'dark');\n
            } else {\n

                root.setAttribute('data-theme', 'light');\n
            }\n

            setStoredTheme(normalized);\n
        }\n

            <script wire:snapshot="{&quot;data&quot;:{&quot;showWarning&quot;:false,&quot;remainingSeconds&quot;:120},&quot;memo&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;p0G7Aqp2ks6oU4GqhkqR&quot;,&quot;name&quot;:&quot;session-timeout-warning&quot;,&quot;path&quot;:&quot;staff\/profile&quot;,&quot;method&quot;:&quot;GET&quot;,&quot;release&quot;:&quot;a-a-a&quot;,&quot;children&quot;:[],&quot;scripts&quot;:[],&quot;assets&quot;:[],&quot;errors&quot;:[],&quot;locale&quot;:&quot;ms&quot;},&quot;checksum&quot;:&quot;f113768da5827cdb7d7b09e73c22d2b436650d34282d1098caec9c56d694e7e8&quot;}" wire:effects="{&quot;partials&quot;:[],&quot;listeners&quot;:[&quot;show-timeout-warning&quot;]}" wire:id="p0G7Aqp2ks6oU4GqhkqR">\n
// Define Alpine data IMMEDIATELY before it's used by the component\n
document.addEventListener('alpine:init', () => {\n
    Alpine.data('sessionTimeout', () => ({\n
        // Session timeout: 30 minutes (1800 seconds)\n
        sessionTimeout: 1800,\n
        // Warning at 28 minutes (1680 seconds)\n
        warningThreshold: 1680,\n
        // Countdown interval\n
        countdownInterval: null,\n
        // Time elapsed since last activity\n
        elapsedSeconds: 0,\n
        // Remaining seconds before logout\n
        remainingSeconds: 120,\n
\n
        init() {\n
            // Start monitoring session activity\n
            this.startMonitoring();\n
\n
            // Listen for session extension event\n
            Livewire.on('session-extended', () => {\n
                this.resetTimer();\n
            });\n
\n
            // Reset timer on user activity\n
            ['mousedown', 'keydown', 'scroll', 'touchstart'].forEach(event => {\n
                document.addEventListener(event, () => this.resetTimer(), { passive: true });\n
            });\n
        },\n
\n
        startMonitoring() {\n
            // Check session status every second\n
            setInterval(() => {\n
                this.elapsedSeconds++;\n
\n
                // Show warning at 28 minutes\n
                if (this.elapsedSeconds === this.warningThreshold) {\n
                    window.Livewire.find('p0G7Aqp2ks6oU4GqhkqR').call('showWarning');\n
                    this.startCountdown();\n
                }\n
\n
                // Force logout at 30 minutes\n
                if (this.elapsedSeconds >= this.sessionTimeout) {\n
                    window.Livewire.find('p0G7Aqp2ks6oU4GqhkqR').call('logout');\n
                }\n
            }, 1000);\n
        },\n
\n
        startCountdown() {\n
            // Update remaining time every second\n
            this.countdownInterval = setInterval(() => {\n
                this.remainingSeconds--;\n
\n
                if (this.remainingSeconds <= 0) {\n
                    clearInterval(this.countdownInterval);\n
                    window.Livewire.find('p0G7Aqp2ks6oU4GqhkqR').call('logout');\n
                }\n
            }, 1000);\n
        },\n
\n
        resetTimer() {\n
            this.elapsedSeconds = 0;\n
            this.remainingSeconds = 120;\n
\n
            if (this.countdownInterval) {\n
                clearInterval(this.countdownInterval);\n
                this.countdownInterval = null;\n
            }\n
        },\n
\n
        formatTime(seconds) {\n
            const minutes = Math.floor(seconds / 60);\n
            const secs = seconds % 60;\n
            return `${minutes}:${secs.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;\n
        }\n
    }));\n
});\n
</script>\n

    (function() {\n
        'use strict';\n
\n
        // Prevent multiple initializations\n
        if (window.__ictserveThemeInit) return;\n
        window.__ictserveThemeInit = true;\n
\n
        const STORAGE_KEY = 'theme';\n
        const DEFAULT_THEME = 'light'; // Immutable default per v3.6.0\n
\n
        /**\n
         * Get theme from localStorage (simple string format)\n
         * @returns {string|null} Theme value or null\n
         */\n
        function getStoredTheme() {\n
            try {\n
                const value = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);\n
                return value === 'dark' ? 'dark' : (value === 'light' ? 'light' : null);\n
            } catch (e) {\n
                return null;\n
            }\n
        }\n
\n
        /**\n
         * Store theme in localStorage (simple string format)\n
         * @param {string} theme - Theme value ('light' or 'dark')\n
         */\n
        function setStoredTheme(theme) {\n
            const normalized = theme === 'dark' ? 'dark' : 'light';\n
            try {\n
                localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, normalized);\n
            } catch (e) {\n
                // Ignore storage errors (private browsing, quota exceeded)\n
            }\n
        }\n
\n
        /**\n
         * Apply theme to document root\n
         * @param {string} theme - Theme value ('light' or 'dark')\n
         */\n
        function applyTheme(theme) {\n
            const normalized = theme === 'dark' ? 'dark' : 'light';\n
            const root = document.documentElement;\n
\n
            if (normalized === 'dark') {\n
                root.classList.add('dark');\n
                root.setAttribute('data-theme', 'dark');\n
            } else {\n
                root.classList.remove('dark');\n
                root.setAttribute('data-theme', 'light');\n
            }\n
\n
            setStoredTheme(normalized);\n
        }\n
\n
        // Initialize theme: stored > default (light)\n
        // v3.6.0: No system preference detection\n
        const initialTheme = getStoredTheme() || DEFAULT_THEME;\n
        applyTheme(initialTheme);\n
\n
        // Expose global theme API for components\n
        window.ICTServeTheme = {\n
            get: function() {\n
                return getStoredTheme() || DEFAULT_THEME;\n
            },\n
            set: function(theme) {\n
                applyTheme(theme);\n
                // Dispatch event for reactive components\n
                window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('theme-changed', {\n
                    detail: {\n
                        theme: theme === 'dark' ? 'dark' : 'light'\n
                    }\n
                }));\n
            },\n
            toggle: function() {\n
                const current = this.get();\n
                const next = current === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark';\n
                this.set(next);\n
                return next;\n
            }\n
        };\n
    })();\n

            <script wire:snapshot="{&quot;data&quot;:{&quot;showWarning&quot;:false,&quot;remainingSeconds&quot;:120},&quot;memo&quot;:{&quot;id&quot;:&quot;VORauUSJNHFtepbZ2hnS&quot;,&quot;name&quot;:&quot;session-timeout-warning&quot;,&quot;path&quot;:&quot;staff\/profile&quot;,&quot;method&quot;:&quot;GET&quot;,&quot;release&quot;:&quot;a-a-a&quot;,&quot;children&quot;:[],&quot;scripts&quot;:[],&quot;assets&quot;:[],&quot;errors&quot;:[],&quot;locale&quot;:&quot;ms&quot;},&quot;checksum&quot;:&quot;f0f7c834a25827b361381e3c8d1b014a1e65cf67e981a67298d7bc2229b63b28&quot;}" wire:effects="{&quot;partials&quot;:[],&quot;listeners&quot;:[&quot;show-timeout-warning&quot;]}" wire:id="VORauUSJNHFtepbZ2hnS">\n
// Define Alpine data IMMEDIATELY before it's used by the component\n
document.addEventListener('alpine:init', () => {\n
    Alpine.data('sessionTimeout', () => ({\n
        // Session timeout: 30 minutes (1800 seconds)\n
        sessionTimeout: 1800,\n
        // Warning at 28 minutes (1680 seconds)\n
        warningThreshold: 1680,\n
        // Countdown interval\n
        countdownInterval: null,\n
        // Time elapsed since last activity\n
        elapsedSeconds: 0,\n
        // Remaining seconds before logout\n
        remainingSeconds: 120,\n
\n
        init() {\n
            // Start monitoring session activity\n
            this.startMonitoring();\n
\n
            // Listen for session extension event\n
            Livewire.on('session-extended', () => {\n
                this.resetTimer();\n
            });\n
\n
            // Reset timer on user activity\n
            ['mousedown', 'keydown', 'scroll', 'touchstart'].forEach(event => {\n
                document.addEventListener(event, () => this.resetTimer(), { passive: true });\n
            });\n
        },\n
\n
        startMonitoring() {\n
            // Check session status every second\n
            setInterval(() => {\n
                this.elapsedSeconds++;\n
\n
                // Show warning at 28 minutes\n
                if (this.elapsedSeconds === this.warningThreshold) {\n
                    window.Livewire.find('VORauUSJNHFtepbZ2hnS').call('showWarning');\n
                    this.startCountdown();\n
                }\n
\n
                // Force logout at 30 minutes\n
                if (this.elapsedSeconds >= this.sessionTimeout) {\n
                    window.Livewire.find('VORauUSJNHFtepbZ2hnS').call('logout');\n
                }\n
            }, 1000);\n
        },\n
\n
        startCountdown() {\n
            // Update remaining time every second\n
            this.countdownInterval = setInterval(() => {\n
                this.remainingSeconds--;\n
\n
                if (this.remainingSeconds <= 0) {\n
                    clearInterval(this.countdownInterval);\n
                    window.Livewire.find('VORauUSJNHFtepbZ2hnS').call('logout');\n
                }\n
            }, 1000);\n
        },\n
\n
        resetTimer() {\n
            this.elapsedSeconds = 0;\n
            this.remainingSeconds = 120;\n
\n
            if (this.countdownInterval) {\n
                clearInterval(this.countdownInterval);\n
                this.countdownInterval = null;\n
            }\n
        },\n
\n
        formatTime(seconds) {\n
            const minutes = Math.floor(seconds / 60);\n
            const secs = seconds % 60;\n
            return `${minutes}:${secs.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;\n
        }\n
    }));\n
});\n
</script>\n
